newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA TO GIVE NEW PROFIT FORECAST LATER.
newsitem.headline: HANSA TO GIVE NEW PROFIT FORECAST LATER.

text.p: Hansapank said on Thursday it will announce a revised 1997 profit and balance sheet forecasts after group results.
Hansapank will publish its group half-year results in week 30, it added in a statement.

"Due to the rapid growth of the whole banking sector as well as Hansapank, after receiving the consolidated half-year results, Hansapank will make public the corrected profit and total assets growth forecasts," the bank said in a statement.
Its half-year profit figure was 73.2 percent of the forecast 256 million kroons for 1997.
